anatomy.creator_words: It looks like it's got kind of a main dorsal wing, and then one, like, further behind it, which I'm actually okay with. So let's keep that ... add a right wing.
anatomy.scope: Exactly four named surfaces: left front wing, right front wing, front dorsal sail, back dorsal sail. Dorsal sails can pivot/lean across the back and overlap/contact each other; keep their roots and free edges distinct from the torso. C selected for refinement, P12 pending.
anatomy.dorsal_position: Main back sail plus a second posterior back sail, as seen in P8.
anatomy.supersedes: Earlier one-dorsal/two-side-wing decision and F1/F2 as complete anatomy references.

latest_markup.wing: Remove old wing in front-left sky, replace behind near wing in downward outlined position
latest_markup.body: Extend rear torso under back sails to marked junction
latest_markup.tails: All long tails originate at the actual posterior body end, not under mid-body

dorsal_mobility.description: Two sail-like dorsal surfaces can pivot sideways/over the body, partly cover one another and brush against another wing. Front sail may hide the start of the back sail; do not fuse their free edges into the rump.
dorsal_mobility.visual_treatment: Subtle root/fold/occlusion clarity, not a redesigned animal or exposed mechanical hinges.

anatomy.tail_length: Three long spindly leaf-tipped tails, each at least snout-to-rump length and preferably clearly longer; widen framing to fit rather than shorten.
anatomy.front_right_direction: Slightly more forward and more extended than P11C's triangular form, anatomically equivalent to left front wing.

generation_check: First draft added extra underbody membrane; final removes only that fifth surface.
